subject: a canary portrait combining a camera lens and paper petals
pose: head cocked with one folded paper wing forward
art_direction: 金丝雀头部由老相机镜头与纸花组合，红黄蓝套印构成荒诞拼贴肖像，表情由倾斜角度传达。
composition: one original central subject with a clear silhouette and circular-crop safe focal point
creative_direction: Compose an original canary portrait as a retro print collage: the head is a plain camera lens surrounded by a small fan of paper petals, while the body and one forward wing remain recognizable bird shapes. Use mustard yellow, brick red, and cobalt ink on warm cream paper, with slight registration shifts confined to the outer color edges. Tilt the lens-head to convey curiosity without adding facial features. Keep the lens rings broad and blank, with no brand or numbers. The paper wing should overlap the body in one clear diagonal. Center the compact collage within the circular-crop area of a square avatar, avoiding background ephemera, text, or extra found objects.
style_inspiration: Entirely original text-only concept, no IP characters, copied artwork, celebrity likeness or named artist imitation.
